requirements: Show current effective rules before posting; inspect rejection reason

findings.title: Place effective rules before the posting controls
findings.detail: rulesView appends the rules section after the primary Check action and review fee button and after Confirm and send / saved confirmation. On a 390x844 viewport with valid longer local rules, the enabled confirm is visible at y400.56–442.56 while the rules extend y484.56–1322.09 beyond dialog bottom801.80. The user can activate publication before encountering most rules text.
findings.fix: Place the rules section before the primary review/send controls, including restored/saved publication paths. Preserve existing text rendering, refresh gating and cancellation/recovery controls; no new checkbox required.

assessment: Verified real public-projection boardFeed returns current mainPolicy and matching board mainVersion/mainRules, complete public-index envelope, boardId and rejection reason.
Verified public-events validates SubboardCreated local_policy_version 1 and contract main.nr publishes/enforces local version 1. Hardcoded displayed immutable local version matches actual semantics.
Inert text nodes, fresh prepare/confirm checks, changed-policy re-review, rejected/unavailable blocking, destination fencing and shared in-flight reads are covered by focused browser checks.
Cancellation and read-only reconciliation controls are not gated by policy readiness. No new timer or per-keystroke RPC introduced.
limits: No chain, service or full journey. Public API/live account check reported by root is corroborative only, not substituted for independent source/browser review. Same coherent candidate needs placement repair and affected recheck.
